g:HTMLPanel.p: Core uses Bootstrap Icons: Icon, and the icon property of buttons, links and list items.

d:Example.heading: Basic
d:Example.description: `icon` takes the name of an `IconTypeBI` constant (`setType(IconTypeBI)` in Java). Icons are text, so color and size them like text: `emphasis`, or utilities such as `fs-2`.

d:Example.heading: In other widgets
d:Example.description: Buttons, links, nav items and headings take an `icon` too.

d:Example.heading: Clickable icons
d:Example.description: An `Icon` has `addClickHandler`; give it a role and a label so it is usable from the keyboard and by screen readers.
